english: The online Research Ethics course for graduate students for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year has been extended until 31 Oct 2026 (Sat). Graduate students who have not yet completed it should take the course within this period.
- 2026-2) 대학원생을 위한 연구윤리(인문사회계 / 이공계) (Research Ethics for Graduate Students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering))
- 2026-2) Research ethics for graduate students(Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering)
B. Who must take the course
- New graduate students admitted for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year
- Current students who have not completed a research ethics course or the online research ethics training
※ Graduate students participating in BK21 (a government-funded graduate research support program) may take the course until December 2026.
D. How to take the course

- Go to eTL (SNU's online learning system, https://etl.snu.ac.kr) → click ‘SNUON-강좌목록’ (SNUON – Course List) on the left → search for ‘연구윤리 / Ethics’ → enrol in the course for your field → take the course
※ The course counts as completed when you watch 100% of all videos and download and open the learning materials (PDF). After completing the course, you can print your own certificate of completion.
Attachment: Guide to the Graduate Research Ethics Course for the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year (Korean/English), 1 copy each.
